Hi  Yatindra,

A beauty film usually means weeks of shoot prep before anyone sees a single frame. For Eclipse Solaire, we made the entire campaign with AI. No set, no shoot day.

They wanted their pink-tinted matte sunscreen repositioned as Blush Pop for Gen Z at Nykaa Land. Our AI team built a Barbie-pink world where everything turns pink as she applies it.

The models, skin tones, costumes, sets and even the Blush Pop jingle were all AI-generated, each approved by the brand. Three films in 15 days.

Ideation → AI Production → Post-Production → Final Deliverable
Everything in-house. No vendor fragmentation.

Got 20 minutes for a Google Meet? We can cook up some AI film concepts for Iberia Skinbrands.



Kind Regards,
